title: Describing a Person at Reception
situation: A visitor describes the person they are meeting so reception can call the right office.
somali_situation: Soo booqde ayaa sharxaya qofka uu la kulmayo si soo-dhoweyntu ugu wacdo xafiiska saxda ah.
key_phrases: I am looking for a person here.
Is it a man or a woman?
Many people work in this office.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: I am looking for a person here.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Is it a man or a woman?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Many people work in this office.
dialogue.somali: Dad badan ayaa ka shaqeeya xafiiskan.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.somali: Waan garanayaa qofka aad ula jeeddo.

title: Describing Appearance to Find a Friend
situation: A visitor describes a friend's appearance to a hotel worker in a busy lobby.
somali_situation: Soo booqde ayaa shaqaale hoteel u sharxaya muuqaalka saaxiib uu ka raadinayo hool mashquul ah.
key_phrases: He has short hair and glasses.
He is wearing a gray jacket.
I saw him in the lobby.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: He has short hair and glasses.
dialogue.somali: Timo gaaban iyo ookiyaale ayuu leeyahay.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: He is wearing a gray jacket.
dialogue.somali: Wuxuu xiran yahay jaakad cawl ah.

dialogue.speaker: Hotel Worker
dialogue.english: I saw him in the lobby.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Great. I will go there now.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Hadda halkaas ayaan aadayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Hotel Worker
dialogue.english: He is sitting near the window.

title: Describing a New Teacher
situation: Two students talk about a new teacher's personality after the first lesson.
somali_situation: Laba arday ayaa ka hadlaya dabeecadda macallin cusub ka dib casharkii ugu horreeyay.
key_phrases: What is the teacher's personality like?
She is patient when we make mistakes.
That kind of teacher helps me learn.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.english: What is the teacher's personality like?

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.somali: Waxay u muuqataa mid saaxiibtinimo leh laakiin aamusan.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.english: She is patient when we make mistakes.
dialogue.somali: Way samirtaa marka aan khalad samayno.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.somali: Taasi way u fiican tahay bilowga.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.english: Yes, but she is strict about homework.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin shaqada guriga way ku adag tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.somali: Waxyaabaha si cad ma u sharaxdaa?

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.english: I was too, but the lesson felt calm.
dialogue.somali: Aniguna sidaas ayaan ahaa, laakiin casharku wuu degganaa.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.english: That kind of teacher helps me learn.
dialogue.somali: Macallinka noocaas ah wuxuu iga caawiyaa inaan barto.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.english: Me too. I want to stay in her class.
dialogue.somali: Aniguna sidoo kale. Waxaan rabaa inaan fasalkeeda sii joogo.

title: Choosing Colours for a Sign
situation: A shop owner and designer choose clear colour words for a sign that customers can notice quickly.
somali_situation: Milkiile dukaan iyo naqshadeeye ayaa dooranaya erayo midabbo cad ah oo calaamad macaamiishu si dhakhso ah u arki karaan.
key_phrases: Which colour is easiest to see?
Red is bright but too strong.
Use clear colour words on the sign.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Owner
dialogue.english: Which colour is easiest to see?
dialogue.somali: Midabkee ayaa ugu fudud in la arko?

dialogue.speaker: Designer
dialogue.english: Red is bright but too strong.
dialogue.somali: Casaanku wuu dhalaalayaa laakiin aad buu u xoog badan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Owner
dialogue.english: I do not want the sign to look angry.
dialogue.somali: Ma rabo calaamaddu inay u ekaato mid xanaaqsan.

dialogue.speaker: Designer
dialogue.somali: Buluug madow wuxuu u muuqdaa xirfad.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Owner
dialogue.english: Will customers notice it from the street?
dialogue.somali: Macaamiishu jidka ma ka arki doonaan?

dialogue.speaker: Designer
dialogue.english: Yes, if the letters are white.

dialogue.speaker: Designer
dialogue.somali: Cagaarku wuxuu la jaanqaadayaa qaybta cuntada.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Owner
dialogue.somali: Dukaanku sidoo kale daawo ayuu iibiyaa.

dialogue.speaker: Designer
dialogue.english: Then blue is safer for the main sign.
dialogue.somali: Markaa buluuggu waa ka habboon yahay calaamadda weyn.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Owner
dialogue.somali: Gudaha cagaar ma ku isticmaali karnaa?

dialogue.speaker: Designer
dialogue.english: Yes, green can mark the food shelves.
dialogue.somali: Haa, cagaar wuxuu calaamadayn karaa shelf-yada cuntada.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Owner
dialogue.somali: Fadlan qoraalka ka dhig mid fudud.

dialogue.speaker: Designer
dialogue.english: Use clear colour words on the sign.
dialogue.somali: Calaamadda ku isticmaal erayo midab oo cad.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Owner
dialogue.english: Good. Blue outside and green inside.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Buluug bannaanka, cagaar gudaha.

title: Choosing the Shape of a Table
situation: A customer chooses a table by describing simple shapes.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa miis dooranaya isagoo sharxaya qaabab fudud.
key_phrases: Do you have a square table?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Do you have a square table?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.somali: Miiska afar-geeska ahi wuu yar yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxay ku habboon yihiin qolal yar.

title: Choosing the Right Bag Size
somali_title: Cabbirka boorso sax ah oo la dooranayo
situation: A customer compares object sizes while choosing a bag for travel.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa isbarbar dhigaya cabbirrada alaabta isagoo dooranaya boorso safar.
key_phrases: The large bag is too heavy.
Do you have a small, light bag?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Do you have a large bag?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, but the large bag is too heavy.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin boorsada weyn aad bay u culus tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Do you have a small, light bag?
dialogue.somali: Boorso yar oo fudud ma haysaan?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, this small one is light.
dialogue.somali: Haa, kan yar wuu fudud yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: Try carrying each size for a moment.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The small one is best for me.
dialogue.somali: Kan yar ayaa aniga ii fiican.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: Good choice for a short trip.
dialogue.somali: Doorasho fiican oo safar gaaban ah.

title: Explaining How You Feel
somali_title: Sida aad dareemayso oo la sharxayo
situation: A patient explains physical feelings to a nurse before seeing the doctor.
somali_situation: Bukaan ayaa kalkaaliye u sharxaya dareenno jireed ka hor inta uusan dhakhtar arkin.
key_phrases: I feel cold, but I am thirsty too.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: A little, when I stand up.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Do you feel hot or cold?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: I feel cold, but I am thirsty too.
dialogue.somali: Qabow ayaan dareemayaa, laakiin sidoo kale waan oommanahay.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: No, I do not want food.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Please sit here and drink some water.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan halkan fadhiiso oo biyo cab.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Thank you. I will wait for the doctor.

title: Talking About Emotions After a Move
somali_title: Dareenno guuritaan ka dib laga hadlayo
situation: A learner talks with a friend about mixed emotions after moving to a new city.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa saaxiib kala hadlaya dareenno isku qasan ka dib markii uu magaalo cusub u guuray.
key_phrases: You should be proud of yourself.
Talking about it makes me calmer.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.somali: Dareennadaydu maanta way isku qasan yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: That makes sense. It is your first week here.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa la fahmi karaa. Waa toddobaadkaagii koowaad halkan.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: New places can feel quiet at first.
dialogue.somali: Meelo cusub marka hore way u ekaan karaan aamusan.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: I am worried about speaking English.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan ka walwalsanahay ku hadalka Ingiriisiga.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: You should be proud of yourself.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: I do not feel proud yet.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: You came, you asked for help, and you kept going.
dialogue.somali: Waad timid, caawimaad ayaad codsatay, waadna sii wadatay.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: What would help you feel calm tonight?
dialogue.somali: Maxaa caawa kaa caawin lahaa inaad degto?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Maybe a short walk and a phone call home.
dialogue.somali: Waxaa laga yaabaa socod gaaban iyo wicitaan guriga ah.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.somali: Taasi waxay u muuqataa mid deggan oo suurtagal ah.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Talking about it makes me calmer.
dialogue.somali: Ka hadalkiisu wuxuu iga dhigaa mid ka deggan.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: I am glad you told me.
dialogue.somali: Waan ku faraxsanahay inaad ii sheegtay.

title: Describing Today's Weather
situation: Two neighbors describe the weather before deciding whether to walk to the market.
somali_situation: Laba deris ayaa sharxaya cimilada ka hor inta aysan go'aansan inay suuqa u lugeeyaan.

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor B
dialogue.somali: Qorrax baa jirta, laakiin dabayl bay leedahay.

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor B
dialogue.english: No, I do not think so.

title: Describing a Lost Object
situation: A customer describes a lost object at a store counter so staff can identify it.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa miiska dukaanka ku sharxaya shay lumay si shaqaaluhu u aqoonsadaan.
key_phrases: I lost an object in the store.
It is a phone with a black case.
The screen has a small scratch.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I lost an object in the store.

dialogue.speaker: Store Worker
dialogue.english: What kind of object is it?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It is a phone with a black case.

dialogue.speaker: Store Worker
dialogue.english: Does the phone have a mark?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The screen has a small scratch.

dialogue.speaker: Store Worker
dialogue.english: Yes. This phone matches your description.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Taleefankan wuxuu la mid yahay sharaxaaddaada.
